text: 为规范银行间债券市场债券发行行为，维护市场秩序，促进债券市场高质量发展，中国人民银行制定了《银行间债券市场债券发行管理规则》，现面向社会公开征求意见。
text_en: To regulate bond issuance conduct in the interbank bond market, maintain market order, and promote high-quality development of the bond market, the People's Bank of China has formulated the Administrative Rules for Bond Issuance in the Interbank Bond Market and is now publicly soliciting comments.
